speaker: john_heminges
text: Saturday. The week is this table. I have the book. I do not have your coffer, and I do not want it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The coffer stays at home, shut. Tell the share.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: On the line, John, if you please. Not a flourish at the foot that makes the week look kinder than the days.

speaker: john_heminges
text: On the line. Monday, Navarre. Tuesday, Egeon. Wednesday, the other king. Thursday, Egeon again. Friday, that king in the afternoon, after a morning that took no money. Today, Egeon, and the yard stayed.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Say the figure before Kemp bows it into a speech.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thirty-four shillings a share.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Thirty-four.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Best since Whitsun. I have looked back along the book. I am not decorating it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thirty-four. I'll take the shillings. A morning that paid us in a curtain is not this sum.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Sweet Master Shakespeare. Hold your hand out. Thirty-four, and I am not shorting you for the toothache.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The toothache is not a charge. Count it plain. I will not dance for it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have counted it plain. Thirty-four. You may look, since you trust a clown's hands less than a column.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And the tiring-house talk does not go in the book. I heard a name on Tuesday. I do not want her in a column.

speaker: john_heminges
text: A maid's name is not a receipt. Nor is a ship at Plymouth. Nor is a morning in which we took nothing at the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Little riches took nothing off this line. Leave the ship off it. The share is the share.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nick was exact in the gown yesterday. I am not entering a grain in a column.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The grain stays out of the book. Thirty-four is the share.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Then thirty-four stands on its own line. Do not let the foot of the page flatter the week.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I am richer by thirty-four, and by an apple I ate on Friday, which I do not expect you to enter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Enter the thirty-four. The apple is between Will and God. I am taking the stack home, and I am not ruling it into the coffer.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Take it home, then. And sleep, if that jaw will let thee. I need thee heard on Thursday, not heroic over a table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The king is Thursday. I have already said after, and I meant him. God keep you, John.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And you. Thirty-four, and the book shut on the line where the sum is.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: God keep you.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And the apple unentered. I shall deny I agreed with Kemp, if any man asks me tomorrow.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: The line is the line. I have followed it. It holds.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Daily, still, sweet Master Shakespeare. Sunday is not here to save you.
